create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-water-in-object.md
create_patterns.content: Task: 'Put a bowl with water in it in the cabinet.' Truth: pick_clean_then_place. Nothing loaded. 'water' with no clean/wash/wet word was read as a plain move. Cue: water-related wording points to the sinkbasin skill. Descriptions in iterations 0-2 all scored 0 because no skill was loaded.

create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-plural-without-number.md
create_patterns.content: Task: 'Move the alarm clocks on the desk to the drawer shelf.' Truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing loaded. The task has a plural noun and no digit or the word 'two'. Descriptions that key only on the word 'two' miss it. Cue: a plural object noun means the two-object skill.

create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-put-away-two.md
create_patterns.content: Task: 'Put away two pencils in bedside table.' Truth: pick_two_obj_and_place. Nothing loaded, even though 'two' is explicit. 'Put away' phrasing looked like a plain move. A count word should override the plain-move default.

create_patterns.name: selection-no-load-for-clean-then-microwave-destination.md
create_patterns.content: Task: 'Put a clean tomato in the microwave.' Truth: pick_clean_then_place. Nothing loaded. The microwave is only the destination. 'clean' decides the skill, not the appliance named. Related to selection-missed-clean-when-microwave-mentioned.
